metadata.article_title: Relevancy of entry in public record or an electronic record made in performance of duty

article.title: Relevancy of entry in public record or an electronic record made in performance of duty
article.content:
29Relevancy of entry in public record or an electronic record made in performance of duty

Section 29 · Part II · Chapter II · Statements made under special circumstances
An entry in any public or other official book, register or record or an electronic record, stating a fact in issue or relevant fact, and made by a public servant in the discharge of his official duty, or by any other person in performance of a duty specially enjoined by the law of the country in which such book, register or record or an electronic record, is kept, is itself a relevant fact.
